source_note: Sequential benchmark transcribed from the original Colab console output; per-round values were not kept. 'NanoCNNv2_distilled' was most likely the first distilled checkpoint (T=4, alpha=0.5, 33.2% test accuracy; benchmark_repeated.py default path) and has the same architecture as NanoCNNv2, so its 0.569 vs 0.375 ms gap is measurement drift, not a property of the model. See docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md.
